entities.summary: Lu Yen-hsun is a Taiwanese tennis coach and a former professional player, who goes by the nickname Rendy Lu. He won the most titles on the ATP Challenger Tour in tennis history. His favorite surface was hardcourt, though several of his ATP Tour career highlights came on grass, including reaching the quarterfinals of the 2010 Wimbledon Championships. Lu became the first player from Taiwan to break into the ATP top 100 in 2004.
